EXPLORE OUR MUSIC
01 / ABOUT US

WHO WE ARE

DIXIEDURRR is an original girl group project created around music, performance, visuals, and imagination. Our songs can jump from dark and dramatic to chaotic, playful, dreamy, glamorous, or completely unexpected.

Every release is part of the DIXIEDURRR world.

02 / TRAINEE PROFILES

THE DIXIEDURRR TRAINEE PROJECT

DIXIEDURRR is presented as a fictional K-pop trainee project built around the feeling of an intense entertainment-company competition.

The trainee profiles introduce Ayano, Juno, Lumii, and Kayla as four performers developing their own identities, skills, and stage presence before becoming DIXIEDURRR.

The concept takes inspiration from the visual language of K-pop trainee competitions: profile photos, practice-room styling, evaluation-style profiles, performance preparation, and dramatic promotional materials — while remaining an original DIXIEDURRR universe.

TRAININGVocals • Dance • Rap • Performance
PROFILEIndividual identity • Style • Position
COMPETITIONEvaluations • Stages • Team missions
